heading.title: Of the Investment of Funds to Provide for Legacies

article.title: Procedure when no fund charged with, or appropriated to, annuity.
article.content: Where an annuity is given and no fund is charged with its payment or appropriated by the will to answer it, a Government annuity of the specified amount shall be purchased, or, if no such annuity can be obtained, then a sum sufficient to produce the annuity shall be invested for that purpose in securities of the kind mentioned in section 341.
article.html:
343Procedure when no fund charged with, or appropriated to, annuity.

Section 343 · Part IX · Chapter X · page 88 of the Act

Where an annuity is given and no fund is charged with its payment or appropriated by the will to answer it, a Government annuity of the specified amount shall be purchased, or, if no such annuity can be obtained, then a sum sufficient to produce the annuity shall be invested for that purpose in securities of the kind mentioned in section 341.
